unit_rule: Index 199 is the same frozen JOSS publication concept. The later ref, revision, provider responses, archives, files and requests are evidence about that unit, not additional units.
allowed_authorities: Zenodo official record and checksum-bound file API
GitHub official REST ref and commit APIs, raw-content endpoint and immutable-revision codeload endpoint

predeclared_requests: GET the exact Zenodo file content URL returned for TARGENE/targene-pipeline-v0.13.4.zip

normalization_and_comparison.archive_format: ZIP only; a non-ZIP response fails closed
normalization_and_comparison.safe_paths: Reject absolute paths, parent traversal and entries outside exactly one archive root directory.
normalization_and_comparison.root_normalization: Remove exactly one top-level directory component from every non-directory member independently in each ZIP. Reject any archive with zero or multiple top-level roots.
normalization_and_comparison.included_entries: All regular files and symbolic links after root removal. Directory entries are structural only and excluded from the manifest.
normalization_and_comparison.equality_rule: Pass only if the two sorted manifests have identical normalized path sets and each corresponding entry has identical type, bytes, byte count and executable-bit state.
normalization_and_comparison.large_payload_rule: Do not retain the downloaded ZIP bodies in the packet. Retain URL, final URL, HTTP status, headers, byte count, MD5, SHA-256 and exact normalized per-entry manifests.
